prompt: CSS box-shadow spread distance corner radius adjustment proportion
answer:
When the border radius is smaller than the spread distance, the spread distance is multiplied by:

\[
1 + (r - 1)^3
\]

where:

\[
r = \frac{\text{border radius}}{\text{spread distance}}
\]

This adjustment is used when calculating the corner radii of the spread shadow shape. (W3C CSSWG issue #1900)
